canonical_source.behavior: The static Access Denied page exposes a visible Return home anchor whose href is exactly /. The control is navigation-only and does not mutate data or invoke a service, queue, WordPress, or provider runtime.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The real rendered Blade control preserves the AIMWWeb Return home behavior and targets the real Laravel root route. It does not target a tenant SPA catch-all and does not fabricate a destination.

authorization.permission: none; navigation is intentionally public and performs no privileged operation
authorization.security_result: No permission bypass is introduced because neither route carries a tenant/user/resource identifier and the control only navigates to the public root.

tenant_isolation.proof: Anonymous, authenticated Tenant A, and authenticated Tenant B callers receive byte-identical denial/control HTML. Tenant and user sentinel values are absent from the response. Source and destination accept zero route parameters.
tenant_isolation.direct_id_idor: not exposed; source and destination have no tenant, user, membership, resource, or generic ID parameter

coverage: actual rendered canonical operation marker and exact href=/
Tenant A/Tenant B/anonymous identical static control response
zero route parameters and no direct-ID/IDOR surface

canonical_denominator.note: This is the isolated one-operation contribution against the latest generated reconciliation authority. Parallel unmerged worker PRs are intentionally not folded into these counts.

terminality.basis: Real user-visible source-equivalent navigation is bound to the exact canonical operation, reaches a real explicit destination, is tenant/identity neutral by source contract, is deterministically acceptance-tested, and the implementation head passed all authoritative repository gates. The evidence-bearing final head must also be exact-head green before handoff completion.
